control_points.datastore: Authorize CRUD on data nodes within conventional/operational datastores
control_points.notification: Authorize receipt of specific event streams/types

sensitivity_tagging.default-deny-write: Machine-readable YANG extension to automatically deny write access to sensitive nodes
sensitivity_tagging.default-deny-all: Machine-readable YANG extension to automatically deny all access (R/W/X) to critical nodes

evaluation_order: Resolve user groups (local + external if enabled)
Iterate rule-lists (ordered-by user) matching user's groups
Iterate rules (ordered-by user) within matching rule-lists
Rule match criteria: (module-name == * | TargetModule) && (rule-type == protocol-operation && rpc-name == * | TargetRPC) && (access-operations == exec | *)
If matched: action == permit => Allow; action == deny => Deny
If no match: if rpc contains 'nacm:default-deny-all' => Deny
If rpc == <kill-session> or <delete-config> => Deny
Else: Fall back to exec-default
Resolve groups
Iterate rule-lists matching user's groups
Iterate rules within lists
Rule match criteria: (module-name == * | TargetModule) && (rule-type == data-node && path matches target_node_or_descendant) && (access-operations == current_op | *)
If matched: action == permit => Allow; action == deny => Deny
If no match:
- If read && node has 'default-deny-all' => Deny
- If write && node has 'default-deny-write' | 'default-deny-all' => Deny
- If read => fallback to read-default
- If write => fallback to write-default
- If execute (action) => fallback to exec-default
data_node_check.implicit_side_effects: No NACM access rights are required for data nodes implicitly changed by server-side evaluation (when-stmt, choice-stmt).

evaluation_order: If nested notification: verify read access to ancestor hierarchy + notification node via Data Node Check
If top-level notification: resolve groups, parse rules matching rule-type 'notification' and access-operations 'read'
If matched: action == permit => Send; action == deny => Drop
If no match: if event has 'default-deny-all' => Drop
Else: fallback to read-default

rule.name: string
rule.access-operations: union [matchall-string-type, bits [create, read, update, delete, exec]]
